name: DISABLE DISK TIMEOUT
description: Prevents hard drives from spinning down after idle periods.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_DISK DISKIDLE 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE DISPLAY TIMEOUT
description: Prevents the monitor from turning off due to idle timeout.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_VIDEO VIDEOIDLE 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: ULTIMATE PERFORMANCE PLAN
description: Activates the hidden Ultimate Performance power scheme for zero power savings.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$a = (powercfg /getactivescheme) -replace '.*([a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}).*','$1'; if ($a -eq 'e9a42b02-d5df-448d-aa00-03f14749eb61') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE WIFI SENSING
description: Disables WiFi network sensing and hotspot sharing background features.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\PolicyManager\default\WiFi\AllowWiFiHotSpotReporting' -Name 'value' -ErrorAction Stop).value; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE ADAPTIVE BRIGHTNESS
description: Disables automatic screen brightness adjustment based on ambient light.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_VIDEO ADAPTBRIGHT 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE HYBRID SLEEP
description: Disables hybrid sleep mode that combines sleep and hibernation states.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$h = powercfg /a 2>&1; if ($h -match 'Hybrid Sleep.*:.*Off|hibernation.*not.*available') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: POWER BUTTON ACTION
description: Sets the power button action to do nothing instead of shutting down.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS PBUTTONACTION 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: LID CLOSE ACTION
description: Sets the laptop lid close action to do nothing on AC power.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_BUTTONS LIDACTION 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE HIBERBOOT
description: Disables fast startup hybrid boot that uses hibernation for quicker boots.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$h = powercfg /a 2>&1; if ($h -match 'hibernation.*not.*available|Fast Startup') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE FAST STARTUP
description: Enables Windows fast startup hybrid boot for quicker system boot times.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power' -Name 'HiberbootEnabled' -ErrorAction Stop).HiberbootEnabled; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE WAKE TIMERS
description: Prevents scheduled system wake timers from waking the computer from sleep.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_SLEEP RTCWAKE 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE CONNECTED STANDBY
description: Disables modern standby (S0 low-power idle) for traditional S3 sleep support.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power' -Name 'CsEnabled' -ErrorAction Stop).CsEnabled; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE BANDWIDTH SAVING
description: Disables network bandwidth saving features that limit background throughput.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile' -Name 'NetworkThrottlingIndex' -ErrorAction Stop).NetworkThrottlingIndex; if ($v -eq 10) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE CPU POWER MANAGEMENT
description: Disables processor power management to prevent dynamic frequency scaling.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerSettings\54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00' -Name 'Value' -ErrorAction Stop).Value; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE THROTTLE STATE
description: Prevents OS from lowering processor performance due to thermal or power limits.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR THROTTLING 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE USB POWER SAVING
description: Stops USB root hub power management to maintain consistent peripheral connectivity.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_USB USB_SELECTIVE_SUSPEND 2>&1; if ($r -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: USB CONTROLLER PRIORITY
description: Raises IRQ priority for USB host controllers for lower input latency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'DevicePriority' -ErrorAction Stop).DevicePriority; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE USB SELECTIVE SUSPEND
description: Prevents individual USB devices from entering selective suspend states.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USB\Parameters' -Name 'DisableSelectiveSuspend' -ErrorAction Stop).DisableSelectiveSuspend; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE USB DEBUG MODE
description: Enables USB debug mode for maximum endpoint bandwidth allocation.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'DebugLevel' -ErrorAction Stop).DebugLevel; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE USB AUTOSUSPEND
description: Disables automatic USB device suspension by the hub driver.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'AutoSuspend' -ErrorAction Stop).AutoSuspend; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: USB TRANSFER SIZE
description: Increases maximum USB transfer size for improved data throughput.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'MaxTransferSize' -ErrorAction Stop).MaxTransferSize; if ($v -eq 1048576) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE USB PORT POWER
description: Prevents USB ports from being powered down during system idle.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'PortPowerDown' -ErrorAction Stop).PortPowerDown; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: USB LATENCY MODE
description: Configures USB controller for minimum latency over power efficiency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'IdleLatency' -ErrorAction Stop).IdleLatency; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE USB ERROR REPORTING
description: Disables USB error reporting to WER to reduce background I/O.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'ErrorReporting' -ErrorAction Stop).ErrorReporting; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE XHCI HANDOFF
description: Enables extended host controller interface handoff for USB 3.0 controllers.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBXHCI\Parameters' -Name 'XhciHandoff' -ErrorAction Stop).XhciHandoff; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE LEGACY USB
description: Disables legacy USB support in the Windows USB stack for modern controllers.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'LegacySupport' -ErrorAction Stop).LegacySupport; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: USB CONTROLLER IRQ
description: Sets USB controller IRQ priority to high for reduced interrupt latency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\PriorityControl' -Name 'IRQ8Priority' -ErrorAction Stop).IRQ8Priority; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE USB DEVICE SLEEP
description: Prevents connected USB devices from entering idle sleep states.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'DeviceSleep' -ErrorAction Stop).DeviceSleep; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: USB DMA PROTECTION
description: Enables DMA remapping protection for connected USB devices.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Kernel DMA' -Name 'DeviceEnumerationPolicy' -ErrorAction Stop).DeviceEnumerationPolicy; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE USB STREAMING
description: Enables isochronous USB streaming mode for real-time audio/video devices.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'StreamingMode' -ErrorAction Stop).StreamingMode; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE SLEEP MODE
description: Prevents system from entering low-power sleep states automatically.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r1 = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_SLEEP STANDBYIDLE 2>&1; $r2 = powercfg /query SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_SLEEP HIBERNATEIDLE 2>&1; if ($r1 -match '0x0' -and $r2 -match '0x0') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE HIBERNATION
description: Removes hiberfil.sys and disables hibernation to reclaim disk space.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = powercfg /a 2>&1; if ($r -match 'Hibernation has not been enabled|Hibernate.*not.*available') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE STORE AUTO-UPDATE
description: Prevents Microsoft Store from automatically downloading and installing app updates.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsStore' -Name 'AutoDownload' -ErrorAction Stop).'AutoDownload'; if ($v -eq 2) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE XHCI HANDOFF
description: Disables XHCI handoff to reduce USB controller latency.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBXHCI\Parameters' -Name 'XhciHandoff' -ErrorAction Stop).XhciHandoff; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: MAX USB TRANSFER SIZE
description: Sets maximum USB transfer size to 1MB for better throughput.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'MaxTransferSize' -ErrorAction Stop).MaxTransferSize; if ($v -eq 1048576) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE USB PRIORITY
description: Gives USB devices higher priority in the system scheduler.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'DevicePriority' -ErrorAction Stop).DevicePriority; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE USB PORT POWER
description: Keeps USB ports powered on at all times.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'PortPowerDown' -ErrorAction Stop).PortPowerDown; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE USB LEGACY SUPPORT
description: Enables legacy USB support for older devices.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'LegacySupport' -ErrorAction Stop).LegacySupport; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE USB IDLE LATENCY
description: Sets USB idle latency to zero for maximum responsiveness.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'IdleLatency' -ErrorAction Stop).IdleLatency; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE IRQ PRIORITY
description: Gives IRQ8 higher priority for better input device responsiveness.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Control\PriorityControl' -Name 'IRQ8Priority' -ErrorAction Stop).IRQ8Priority; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE USB ERROR REPORTING
description: Enables USB error reporting for debugging.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'ErrorReporting' -ErrorAction Stop).ErrorReporting; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE KERNEL DMA PROTECTION
description: Disables kernel DMA protection for device enumeration.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Kernel DMA' -Name 'DeviceEnumerationPolicy' -ErrorAction Stop).DeviceEnumerationPolicy; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE USB DEVICE SLEEP
description: Allows USB devices to enter sleep mode when idle.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'DeviceSleep' -ErrorAction Stop).DeviceSleep; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: DISABLE USB DEBUG
description: Sets USB debug level to zero for production performance.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'DebugLevel' -ErrorAction Stop).DebugLevel; if ($v -eq 0) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"

name: ENABLE USB AUTO SUSPEND
description: Enables automatic USB suspend when devices are idle.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\System\CurrentControlSet\Services\USBHUB3\Parameters' -Name 'AutoSuspend' -ErrorAction Stop).AutoSuspend; if ($v -eq 1) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
